purpose: Close the five residual canonical-role review gaps with explicit source-backed local evidence or an explicit reviewed global-only disposition. A reviewed global-only disposition is not a Nigerian demand claim.

sources.name: Nigerian winter-sports and ski-instruction context
sources.scope: Nigerian winter-sports participation, federation activity and a Nigerian skier's instructional activity
findings: The Bobsled and Skeleton Federation of Nigeria provides Nigerian winter-sports federation context.
The African winter-sports material includes Nigeria in an African winter-sports context.
A published profile of Nigerian skier Samuel Ikpefan describes cross-country skiing instruction, supporting a Nigerian participant/instructor context.
sources.limitations: These sources do not establish a Nigerian ski-resort labour market, a current vacancy, or a Nigerian licensing requirement for ski or snowboard instructors.

sources.name: Nigerian tobacco-manufacturing equipment-operator role evidence
sources.scope: British American Tobacco Nigeria manufacturing and operator/technician postings, including Ibadan production activity
findings: Public Nigerian postings use equipment operator/technician and production-operator titles for cigarette making or packing machinery.
The postings describe operating, monitoring and maintaining production equipment and meeting process and quality requirements.
The postings show a Nigerian manufacturing context and role-family terminology, but are dated advertisements rather than a permanent demand estimate.
sources.limitations: A job posting is a time-bound market signal. It does not establish universal Nigerian demand, salary, or one mandatory qualification for every employer.

sources.name: Nigerian hop-cultivation and hop-substitute research context
sources.scope: Nigerian brewing inputs, local agricultural research and the distinction between hop-substitute work and commercial hop farming
findings: The checked Nigerian research discusses local hop substitutes and explains the temperate-climate constraints affecting commercial hop supply in Nigeria.
The evidence supports a Nigerian research/agriculture context, not an established commercial Nigerian hop-farmer occupation.
sources.limitations: No direct Nigerian commercial hop-farm role or vacancy was established in the checked evidence. The global role remains visible with this limitation.

skills.name: Operate, monitor and carry out routine checks on cigarette-making or packing production machinery while meeting process and quality requirements
Record production conditions, identify equipment faults and coordinate safe escalation or maintenance support

tools.name: Cigarette-making and packing machinery, production controls, inspection tools, maintenance records and personal-protective equipment
tools.limitation: The exact machine and control system depends on the factory and production line.

competencies.name: Keep a high-volume manufacturing line safe, available, consistent and compliant with operating and quality procedures

certifications.name: Relevant Nigerian production-operations, mechanical, electrical, mechatronics or technical-vocational pathway
certifications.issuer: Employer, NBTE, recognised institution or approved technical provider
certifications.limitation: The postings show education and technical experience expectations, not one universal certification requirement.

regulatory_requirements.name: Factory work must follow applicable Nigerian occupational-safety, machinery, product-quality, environmental and tobacco-manufacturing requirements
